name: PocketPal AI
summary: Polished open-source iOS & Android app for downloading Hugging Face GGUF models and chatting with custom roleplay personas 100% offline.
ranking_rationale: Clean native mobile UI pulls any GGUF straight from Hugging Face onto your phone privately (trade-off: phone battery & 8GB–12GB RAM cap usable models around 4B–8B parameters).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Clean native mobile UI pulls any GGUF straight from Hugging Face onto your phone privately
100% offline local inference—zero account, zero cloud logs, zero censorship
Supports custom system prompts & character personas
cons: Phone battery & 8GB–12GB RAM cap usable models around 4B–8B parameters
Long context slows generation on older chips
